changeSet.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_poem_translations_refresh ON poem_translations
CREATE TRIGGER trg_poem_translations_refresh AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON poem_translations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION poem_translations_refresh_search()

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authors_refresh_poems_search() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE poems p SET search_vec = setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.name, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(NEW.name, ''))), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.content, ''))), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.transliteration, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(p.meaning, ''))), 'D') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce( (SELECT string_agg(content, ' ') FROM poem_translations WHERE poem_id = p.id AND is_deleted = false), ''))), 'D') WHERE p.author_id = NEW.id; RETURN NEW; END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
